name: Yamikin ♂ Seikatsu Totsuka!
original_name: 闇金♂性活 特典凸化!
source:
Four men who could no longer repay their debts were half-forced by the loan shark Butakuma to take a job,
who told them,
“There’s a job where you can make good money—give it a try.”

The job turned out to be idol activities focused on fan events that included sexual entertainment.
It’s a job with a higher turnover rate than the adult entertainment industry and offers higher earnings than typical underground idols.

They are given 25 days to pay off their debts.
If they fail to earn enough by then, they will be sold off as “pets” to wealthy individuals and will never regain their freedom.

Will the four men be able to escape this hell?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/announce/=/product_id/RJ01350663.html/?locale=ja_JP]DLsite[/url]]
